notes.title: 关于1.17版本更新后存档失效的情况通报
notes.content: 在更新1.17版本后，许多玩家向我们反馈了读档崩溃的问题。经过紧急排查，我们确认造成此次事故的原因是开发人员在上线前的内部测试中未能覆盖所有环境，从而未能谨慎评估此问题发生的可能性，在此向广大玩家致歉。此次事故中已发生崩溃的存档可能无法修复，您可以选择退款，或重新开始游戏。此次事故后，我们已针对存档功能加入一套新机制来预防类似事故再次发生。感谢您的支持，再次向您表示我们的歉意。

notes.title: Shan Gui moved to Shan Gui: Definitive Edition
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Fan or not, maybe you've already heard that "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/307050/discussions/0/357287304431021101/]News[/url]" on Shan Gui which we involved in years ago, we're very sorry for the inconvenient on this these years.

To offer the lastest, and also the best experience, on Shan Gui, we once included it in Bai Qu. Since Shan Gui II Chapter 2 has been released early 2020, in order to make it more convenient for you to experience this work, we now annoucend Shan Gui: Definitive Edition - the latest DLC for Shan Gui II. And as a thank you gift to our fans who have been supporting us, it's free!

To offer you a consistent and best experience, we'll remove the files of Shan Gui and it's OST that included in Bai Qu after 90 days. The Shan Gui OST will be included into Shan Gui II OST. And as a celebration on the release of Definitive Edition. We will run a weeklong 50% off discount at 10:00 am May 25th (PDT). Enjoy it :)

notes.title: Version 1.11: Russian & Spanish Version Added
notes.content: Dear all. We are proudly to announce that after months of hard work, we finally finished <Bai Qu>’s Russian and Spanish version. We know there are some friends, who mother tongue those languages, were waiting since last July. You could enjoy this game now, wish you will love it.

notes.title: Bai Qu 1.10 & Shan Gui 1.50
notes.content:
★ Bai Qu 1.10
● Improved the Performance greatly.
● Fixed some mistakes of English translation.
* You might need to move your save files to "baiqu" folder from the "game" folder in game root folder.

　　For a long time we heared from many players that they wanna try Magneta Factory's Shan Gui, but they don't wanna let someone who steal Shan Gui take advantage of it (buy coke for him, as he said). So we decide to embed Shan Gui in BaiQu now. As the two games shared the same Ren'Py engine in this version, so it requires you to have base game Bai Qu to play Shan Gui.

★ Shan Gui 1.50
● This version of Shan Gui assembled graphic resources from both 2012 and 2014 version. You could switch by one click in the Settings, without any influence on the Extra Mode. The switch button is a hidden one on the top of the screen. We implemented some resampling methods on the graphic of 2012 version and make it to 1920*1080 resolution.
● Easter Eggs of Bai Qu has now been moved to the Extra Mode.
● We have remade the dubbing works of Shan Gui since version 1.32. The quality of He Jia and Han Hui's voices has now been improved, we also let the dubbing crew of Bai Qu redub the voice of Li Qiucheng and Teahouse Manager.
● Improved the quality of Ending Animation.
● Since this version shared the same engine with Bai Qu, we optimized the game greatly on features like Fonts Rendering. We also improved the controller supporting.
● Two more languages supported than 1.32 version.
● Slightly adjustment on UI.

notes.title: Initial Release Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Customers:

　I am glad to announce you the new work of Magenta Factory, Bai Qu, will published on Steam platform at 8pm PDT on Thursday, July 27th. The price is for USD 15 each.

　Follow the timeline of Shan Gui, Bai Qu also tells a fantastic story in the daily life of the ancient Chinese city of Nanjing. It takes us more than five years to finish it, wish you would love the story. We know our work isn’t perfect, if you encountered any program bug or have any suggestion, please contact us through Steam or by e-mail (baiqu@cngal.org).

　At the time of the first issuing, we provide three language versions: English, traditional Chinese, simplified Chinese. Besides, we also prepared another versions like Japanese, Russian, French, German and Spanish. Since the amount of work is giant, these versions cannot catch the first issuing. We are sorry about that, but we promise the game will be updated as soon as each language version finished, the same with new DLC. Please be patient.

　Anyway, wish you enjoy this journey to our magenta fairytale.

notes.title: Storepage Debut Announcement
notes.content:
Dear customers. After several years' hard work, Magenta Factory's new work Bai Qu is about to launching. As the store page publicized, we'd like to unveil some of this work's information.

1. This time, Bai Qu will be published all by ourselves to avoid dispute of publishing right.
2. We will have Chinese (traditional and simplified) and English in first issue version. And the translation of Japanese, Russian and French is almost finish, but we are not sure whether them can catch the first issue. Anyway, you will enjoy these language versions soon. If you are a master of other languages and willing to help us to develop new language version, please contact us.
3. Trading cards system is on its way. It will first issue together with the game.
